topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The opening frames the lecture series, its audiences and the learning outcomes for this session.

topics.label: Accumulating genetic and epigenetic changes in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces cancer development as the stepwise accumulation of cellular changes and identifies the questions this model raises.

topics.label: Disrupted differentiation and tissue architecture in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain cancer through the loss of normal tissue organisation and show why studying isolated cells cannot fully capture that disruption.

topics.label: Distinguishing benign and malignant tumors through invasion and metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish how tumor spread distinguishes malignancy from benign growth and how that distinction is recognised clinically and histologically.

topics.label: Tumor progression and the risks of benign growth
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine what can happen to benign tumors, using colorectal progression to demonstrate malignant transformation while clarifying that progression is not inevitable and benign growth can itself be harmful.

topics.label: Tumor nomenclature
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains how tumor names indicate tissue of origin and malignant status, including exceptions to the naming conventions.

topics.label: How cancer causes illness and death
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains how tumor growth compromises normal bodily function and why widespread metastases are especially lethal.

topics.label: Tumor incidence in humans and other animals
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics compare the frequency and distribution of tumors across populations and species.

topics.label: Clinical detection and cancer screening
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the need to detect cancer early and assess how effectively screening can identify treatable disease in different organs.

topics.label: Closing guidance on revision and practicals
topics.groupedBecause: The closing returns to the learning outcomes and directs students toward revision, practicals and the next lecture.
